content: OPEN THREAD: Comms channel needs automated listener. Currently push-only, manual read. Three proposed solutions: (A) Add check-comms step to morning briefing scheduled task — Dispatch reads unread messages and includes in briefing to phone. Easiest immediate win, no new infrastructure. (B) Claude Code UserPromptSubmit hook that silently checks comms before every prompt — deterministic, fires on every session. (C) Dedicated scheduled task polling comms every 30 min and dispatching responses — fully autonomous. Recommend A first (morning briefing already runs), then B for Claude Code sessions. Identified April 3 2026 by iPhone instance while Tony at AutoZone.
